text: DomainNet retained all 30 frozen PACS predictors. Under the primary 512-draw contract, no registered ResNet18 condition certified, and the ConvNeXt-Tiny certification rate was at most 1.3%. The predeclared transfer gate therefore failed. A descriptive 1,024-draw analysis produced greater utility, but it was secondary and did not replace the registered primary decision. Together, the VLCS and DomainNet results locate an evidence-budget and transfer boundary. They do not support a positive untouched-dataset utility claim.
